items.name: Martinez refinery restart
items.claim: PBF Energy's rebuild of its 157,000 bpd Martinez, California refinery following the February 1, 2025 fire is now expected to progress into February, with planned operating rates achieved by the beginning of March 2026.
items.source_excerpt: rebuild activities at its 157,000 barrel per day Martinez, California refinery following the February 1, 2025 fire are now expected to progress into February. PBF expects to achieve planned operating rates by the beginning of March 2026.

notes: Only stored source is the January 2026 Martinez update; the restart itself is the one dated, quantified project disclosure.
